verdict.rationale: Sumsub exposes verification processing through RESTful APIs, and outcomes reach integrations through webhooks and WebSDK event messages that report status changes, so an automated flow can react to verification state. AML screening flags high-risk customers. The pack never shows the structure of the outcome payloads, though: rejection reasons appear only in the Summy AI applicant overview, and liveness results are reviewed in the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable result schemas, structured rejection/failure reason codes in API or webhook payloads, per-check risk scores or signals exposed via API, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths 404), and hands-on corroboration of agent branching on results.
